verdict.rationale: NVIDIA Project G-Assist is described as an AI assistant that lets users tune, control, and optimize their GeForce RTX system, which implies natural-language command operation, but this is a single vendor-doc mention with no detail on command scope, reliability, or independent hands-on validation. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of supported natural-language commands/voice interface, hands-on or independent reviews confirming G-Assist actually works as described, and evidence it extends beyond basic system tuning to broader product operation.
